source: Ladson, C. L., NASA Technical Memorandum 4074 (1988): Effects of Independent Variation of Mach and Reynolds Numbers on the Low-Speed Aerodynamic Characteristics of the NACA 0012 Airfoil Section. Langley Low-Turbulence Pressure Tunnel.
figure: Table VII, Force Coefficients at M = 0.15 for Transition Fixed With No. 60-W Grit, block R = 6.00 x 10^6
digitised_by: Extracted from the PDF text layer of the file whose sha256 is recorded above. Every row cross-checked against the report's own lift-to-drag column: Cl/Cd reproduces it to within 0.024, consistent with rounding at four to five significant figures.
notes: Transition fixed with grit, which is the correct comparison for a fully turbulent computation with no transition model. Experiment is at M = 0.15 against an incompressible computation; the Prandtl-Glauert factor is 1.011, so compressibility accounts for about 1% of lift. Stall occurs between 14.02 and 15.06 degrees with Cl_max 1.2169.
